lines.text: A complex system can be hard to read in one diagram. Keep the overview clear. Open a component when you need more detail.

This is the Transformer example in Archify Labs. Select Transformer Layer and open its internal architecture. The child expands below the main diagram. Its local components have their own Semantic Passport.

The Export menu offers two targets. Main diagram exports the overview. Current subarchitecture exports only the open child. This child SVG contains seven local components. The two exports stay independent.
Use Back to model to return. The page restores your scroll position and parent selection. Larger children can scroll. The main diagram keeps its original behavior.

The BAGEL example follows the official inference code. Open context assembly to inspect text, vision, and VAE paths. Open the MoT layer to see attention and separate feed-forward paths. Source links point to a fixed repository revision.
The Lance example follows a dataset query. Open the scanner to inspect its query plan. Some stages depend on the query options. Then open the Arrow stream bridge. See how Rust batches reach Python.

These views are optional additions in Labs. Each child stays one level deep with up to twelve components. Try Transformer, BAGEL, and Lance in the gallery. Bring a real diagram and share what you find.
